remarks: Live in style in this fully remodeled 2-bedroom condo at Pleasant Manor - perfectly located on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Stamford. Just steps from top restaurants, shops, the Stamford Town Center, and Metro North, this one-floor unit offers unbeatable convenience with a peaceful vibe.  Enjoy open-concept living with a sleek kitchen featuring quartz counters, a large breakfast bar, and modern finishes throughout. The unit boasts central air with smart thermostat, oversized windows, California Closets in both bedrooms, in-unit washer/dryer, and a beautifully updated bathroom with glass doors.  Carport parking under the unit + plenty of guest parking. Move-in ready with updated floors, dimmable lighting, and brand-new hot water heater.  This one checks all the boxes - prime location, modern comfort, and one-level living at its best.
